Target company: Microsoft (MSFT). Microsoft develops software and cloud services including Windows, Microsoft 365 and Azure, and operates gaming, business-software and related technology businesses.

Focal announcement: Unlocking the future of innovation: The Microsoft AI Tour.

Decision cutoff: 2024-08-13T23:59:59-04:00. Use only information available before this cutoff.

Source: Unlocking the future of innovation: The Microsoft AI Tour. Published date: 2024-08-13. URL: https://blogs.microsoft.com/blog/2024/08/13/unlocking-the-future-of-innovation-the-microsoft-ai-tour.

Condensed source passage, selected from the supplied excerpt; other details are omitted: Innovation isn’t just a buzzword — it’s the heartbeat of thought leadership and a catalyst for growth. The Microsoft AI Tour is more than an event; it’s a global movement that will begin September 24, 2024, and span over 60 cities around the world, from Mexico City to Johannesburg, Mumbai to Sydney, Seoul to Berlin, and many more. Plus, dive deep into how AI fits into the Microsoft roadmap, which will help those present align their AI strategies with the latest technologies and best practices. During the event, attendees will have the opportunity to engage with industry-leading experts, partners and members of Microsoft’s senior leadership team. Leaders such as Satya Nadella, Chairman and CEO, and Judson Althoff, Executive Vice President and Chief Commercial Officer, will join us at select stops on the tour, where they’ll share how this new generation of AI is reshaping how people live and work.
